description: This grouped bar chart illustrates the values of $\gamma_B$ across five sequential categories, separated into two distinct conditions. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled in sequential order as 0, 1, 2, 3, and 4. The vertical value axis is labeled "$\gamma_B$" and features a linear scale with numeric tick marks from 0.0 to 0.6 at regular intervals of 0.2, accompanied by horizontal dotted grid lines, though the plotted values extend up to approximately 0.75. The chart displays grouped bars for each category, visually arranged side-by-side. According to the legend positioned at the top, the blue bars with a dotted pattern represent "Incorrect" instances, while the magenta bars with a diagonal line pattern represent "Correct" instances. The bars exhibit a consistent decreasing trend in height for both conditions as the category number increases from 0 to 4. The tallest bar in the chart is the "Correct" bar in category 0, reaching an approximate value of 0.72, while the shortest bar is the "Incorrect" bar in category 4, at approximately 0.30. Other representative values include the "Incorrect" bar in category 0 at roughly 0.41, and the "Correct" bar in category 4 at approximately 0.45. All bars are visually emphasized with solid black outlines and distinct internal patterns to differentiate the categories.
